correctness.rationale: Inducedness requires cyclic selected-edge gaps≥3; maximality forces ≤5. After removing one edge, only insertion within the merged gap can restore maximality, with exact local degree f(a,b)=2−|a+b−8| and transitions of one or two units. Unit adjacent-gap transfers connect bounded compositions to canonical packing; the ordering constraints for moving all edges one step form an acyclic orientation except constant all-3/all-5 gaps, proving connectivity of interior sectors and frozen 3/5 extremes. Transfer-matrix trace enumerates degrees, and a Johnson-graph triangle dichotomy reduces triangles to merged gap length 8; coefficient formulas and Eulerian parity follow. Independent direct maximal-subset exchange-graph enumeration checked all n=7..15; inspected supplied second gap-composition verifier and direct n≤18 code, not confused with infinite proof.
